sources.title: Chatterbox: Open Source Text-to-Speech | Resemble AI
sources.snippet: Chatterbox is Resemble AI's free, open-source TTS model, MIT-licensed with emotion control, real-time generation, and zero-shot voice cloning from 5 seconds of audio.

sources.snippet: Chatterbox Multilingual V3 is the latest general-purpose multilingual TTS model in the Chatterbox family. It keeps the same 0.5B model size while improving speaker similarity, reducing hallucinations, and producing more natural, conversational speech across languages. sources.title: Chatterbox Turbo: Open Source, Ultrafast Text-to-Speech | Resemble AI
sources.snippet: Chatterbox Turbo is Resemble AI's fastest open-source TTS — 350M params, 75ms latency, 6x real-time, with paralinguistic tags and voice cloning from 5 seconds of audio.

sources.title: resemble-ai/chatterbox | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Purpose and Scope This document provides an introduction to the Chatterbox TTS family, a set of three open-source text-to-speech models developed by Resemble AI. It describes the three model variants, their key features, and the shared architectural components that power them. For detailed installation instructions, see Getting Started.
